notes.title: b21s: Challenges & Difficulty (Summer Sale Update)
notes.notes: [h1]Challenges[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472510/715511c2cac5631525fddf056573f4280fc5e3ce.png"][/img][/p][p]This update introduces 20 challenges that you can enable to alter gameplay and introduce new and interesting tactical choices. These range from simple challenges, like disallowing potion use, to extreme ones where you can only have one party slot.[/p][p]Additionally, you'll be able to choose from various difficulty levels (0% to 270%), making the game even harder.[/p][p]The reward is a score multiplier, allowing you to climb even higher on the leaderboard. Are you ready?[/p][p]To keep things fair, the leaderboard will be reset with this update![/p][p][/p][h1]Enhanced Game-Over Screen[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472510/ef4b52e569e64c983a82ae85f690f609531583f7.png"][/img][/p][p]The game-over screen now features various statistics, a breakdown of the score calculation, and your final party. You can also save the game-over screen as a screenshot, which will be placed in the "runs" folder in the game directory for easy sharing.[/p][p][/p][h1]NPC Looks[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472510/7e2101343a82207c82dad1be46f52d117cfec011.png"][/img][/p][p]To give every NPC a bit more personality, each of them features a new larger hand-drawn pixel art portrait when you talk to them. Make sure to keep an eye out for them the next time you play! [/p][p]Credits and huge thanks to [url="https://www.instagram.com/inspiremints/"]@inspiremints[/url] for creating those![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: b19_10s: Important Hotfix
notes.notes: The last update somehow broke the [b]Seed of the Day[/b] and [b]Endless Mode[/b]. It's now working again. Big sorry for the inconveniences!

notes.title: b19_5s: Some QoL changes
notes.notes:
Some QoL changes based on player feedback:

[list]
[*] Added fullscreen mode (can be found in [b]Settings[/b]).
[*] Added a bilinear filtering setting so that fullscreen or maximized mode looks less pixelated.
[*] Adjusted the table sizes of the leaderboard.
[*] Since there are many Japanese players, I added a font with Japanese support for the leaderboard, so that names with Kanji, Hiragana, and Katakana are displayed correctly.
[*] Added custom keybinds to the [b]Settings[/b].
[/list]

[b]日本の皆さん、たくさんのご関心をありがとうございます！[/b]

notes.title: b19_4: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix a problem with the tinkerer that didn't allow item merging
[/list]

notes.title: b19_3: Balance Update + Smaller Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] "Enemies start with -x% HP" no longer stacks. Only the highest effect is applied, up to a maximum of -25%. It won't trigger again after fleeing.
[*] Charm chance is now capped at a maximum of 75%.
[*] Increased charm penalty buildup after level 3.
[*] Increased chance for bosses to block doors.
[*] Slightly nerfed healing (reduced gain from merging, slightly lower base values, and a smaller increase from stats).
[*] Slightly increased enemy power level scaling.
[*] Limited dropped items to a maximum of 3 effects, down from 5.
[*] Lowered percentage value caps on ability-related item effects (reduced to 25% max, down from 85%).
[*] Fixed an issue with the Merge-O-Mat and Meat Grinder consuming side slots, now capped at a 40% chance.
[*] Fixed a crash related to the Tinkerer.
[*] Fixed upgrade point notification appearing unnecessarily.
[*] Added a "Disable audio when window is in background" setting, for everyone playing at work.
[/list]
